title: Gestral Village - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Gestral Village in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Gestral settlement and the game's biggest concentration of optional content, including the arena tournament, several merchants and the missable Medalum weapon.

sections.title: How to Reach Gestral Village
sections.content: Reached from The Continent during Act 1. Most of its content stays available later, but the tournament reward does not.
